problems.eyebrow: Three places your money is leaking
problems.title: Your margin lives or dies on three things.
problems.subtitle: We checked dozens of small kitchens. The same leaks, every time.

card1.title: Overpaying suppliers
card1.body: You don't know which supplier is cheapest. KLEERO scans your receipts and finds where to buy 8–15% cheaper nearby.

card2.title: Food going to waste
card2.body: KLEERO analyzes your menu and predicts which items will spoil first — so you order smarter and waste less.

card3.title: Missing busy days
card3.body: Find concerts, festivals and sports events near you — and get a prep plan before the rush hits.

how.title: Three steps. One chat.
how.subtitle: No software. No training. Same WhatsApp you already use all day.

step1.label: Step 01
step1.title: Open the bot
step1.body: Open KLEERO in WhatsApp or Telegram. Pick your language (EN/ES). Choose your business type. Done in 30 seconds.

step2.label: Step 02
step2.title: Send a receipt
step2.body: Snap a photo of your supplier invoice. KLEERO reads every item — even handwritten receipts in any language.

step3.label: Step 03
step3.title: Get savings
step3.body: KLEERO compares prices at local suppliers and shows you where to buy cheaper — with real links, not guesses.

referral.title: Bring a friend, get one month free.
referral.body: For every restaurant you refer who joins KLEERO, you get +1 month of full access free. No limit on how many friends you can bring.
